text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a non-review empirical research study focused on modeling pollinator (bee) community response to bioenergy crop scenarios. Although it uses land cover data and simulates two bioenergy land use scenarios, the spatial scale is limited to the Lower Peninsula of Michigan (a regional scale), not national-scale implementation. Moreover, the primary focus is on pollinator ecology and ecosystem services response rather than on land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation as a central research question. There is no indication of spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC prediction, nor explicit national-scale mapped LULC projections. The study uses land cover change scenarios as inputs to predict pollinator responses, but does not develop or validate LULC prediction models itself. Therefore, it fails core inclusion criteria regarding scale and primary focus and meets exclusion criteria related to regional scale and species-specific ecological focus unrelated primarily to LULC prediction.)
